text:
Ava (PM): Rolling out "Private Export Controls" to Private/VPC fleets starting canary next Tue. This adds a tenant-level export toggle and richer audit events so customers can prevent data egress from private networks. Read-only internal announcement for now — do not share externally.
Ravi (Eng): Is there an agent bump needed on on-prem clusters?
Marina (Security): Yes — Agent 2.3.1 required. It enforces the toggle locally and emits new audit fields (export_attempt, export_blocked, kms_meta). Also fixes a KMS tagging edge case.
Ava (PM): Correct. Control-plane flag + Agent 2.3.1. Hosted API unaffected. Canary scope: eu-west-1 private pods. If stable we'll promote cluster-wide one week later.
Sam (Legal): Heads-up: we need a short blurb for customer contracts: enabling "allow-exports" shifts export responsibility to the customer. Add to COPC and SOC FAQ.
Ravi (Eng): Canary gating criteria: zero security regressions, <1% increase in request errors, and no spike in latency P95. We’ll have dashboards ready by EOD Friday.
Marina (Security): Security checklist: run blocked-export simulations, verify audit stream to private control plane, ensure KMS metadata survives key rotation.
Jules (Customer Success): I’ll reach out to customers with export constraints — will coordinate upgrade windows and KMS onboarding. Marking 6 customers as priority.
Ava (PM): Customer defaults: new private clusters default to export=deny. Existing clusters remain unchanged until customer opts in. Customers must supply KMS ARNs to persist key metadata in logs.
Ravi (Eng): Admin API example:
PATCH /v1/private/tenants/{tenant_id}/settings
{ "export_control": "deny", "audit_retention_days": 365 }

Manifest change: adding export_control to private-manifest v2.3 schema.
Marina (Security): SIEM teams — look for sudden increases in export_blocked or export_attempt events. New audit fields: event_type, result, source_ip, kms_tag.
Ava (PM): Docs & runbook: internal.redwood.dev/private/export-controls (migration, rollback, customer messaging templates). KB created at internal.redwood.dev/kb/priv-export-2-3-1.
Support-Bot: Support playbook added -> Support runbooks / Private / Export Controls. Canned responses created.
Ravi (Eng): Ops note: Dedicated pools with auto-upgrade ON will receive Agent 2.3.1 at 03:00 UTC Sat. Manual opt-out option available in Console.
Sam (Legal): I'll push the COPC wording today. Also want a short checklist for CSMs to use when customers flip allow-exports.
Ava (PM): Action items:
- Eng (Ravi): finalize canary dashboards & alerts
- Security (Marina): run export simulation suite
- Support: prep KB snippets & canned replies
- CSM (Jules): schedule upgrade calls with priority customers
- Legal (Sam): update COPC and customer-facing FAQ
React with :white_check_mark: when acknowledged. If anything blocks, DM me or @ops. Thanks :rocket:
